subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The arrangements of the little boy's birthday party were ________ nice. We could not help but appreciate it.
solution:
The correct answer is '**extremely**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**extremely**" means very or to a great degree. (अत्यंत)
 
• In the given sentence, the arrangements of the birthday party were highly appreciated because they were "**extremely**" nice.
 
• The other options: "**little**," "**many**," and "**few**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The arrangements of the little boy's birthday party were extremely__ nice. We could not help but appreciate it.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Little (थोड़ा)**: means small in quantity or degree, not fitting the context.
 
• **Many (कई)**: means a large number, which does not describe the arrangements.
 
• **Few (कुछ)**: means a small number, which is not relevant in this context.
